# Randomizer categories

**Generated — do not edit.** `node scripts/randomizer-doc.mjs`

19 boxes · 265 sub-categories · 5,112 options

The randomizer fills the brief box with random terms. Nothing here reaches
a model on its own — you pick categories, roll, edit the result, and then
generate as normal. Image models only.

**How a template works.** A sub-category is either a flat list, where one
option is picked, or a composed template of several slots separated by
commas, where one option is picked from *each* — which is what makes a
creature come out coherent rather than as a loose wing. `term:3` weighs a
term three times as likely. An option reading `no X`, `none` or `nothing`
resolves to silence: it keeps its odds and contributes no words.
